steps: Mix the besan, turmeric and salt in a bowl.
Stir in the onion, tomato, green chilli, ginger and coriander leaves.
Whisk in water little by little until you have a smooth batter that pours like thick cream.
Heat a flat pan on medium and wipe it with a few drops of oil.
Pour in a ladle of batter and quickly spread it into a thin round.
Drizzle a little oil around the edge and cook until the underside has golden spots.
Flip, press down lightly and cook the other side for a minute or two.
Repeat with the rest of the batter and serve hot with chutney or ketchup.
note: A serving is now two chillas, about 50 g of besan; the old amounts were for one. Oil is now counted at about a teaspoon per chilla, and the red chilli powder used by only one source is left out.
